games.title: Snake
games.summary: Steer the snake, eat the food, do not bite yourself.

games.title: Frutiger Falls
games.summary: Stack the falling pieces and clear whole lines.
games.controls: Arrows move, up rotates, space drops

games.title: Frutiger Angler
games.summary: Cast, wait for the bite, and keep the line inside the bar.
games.controls: Hold space or press and hold to cast, then reel

games.title: Seal Scroller
games.summary: An endless vertical feed of seals: slow-panning photos and playing clips.
games.controls: Scroll or arrow keys. Tap a clip to pause it

games.title: Block Blast
games.summary: Click a block, then click a cell to place it. Clear the lines, do not fill the board.
games.controls: Click a block, then a cell. R restarts

games.summary: Slide tiles, merge matching numbers, reach 2048. Frutiger Aero edition.

games.title: Frutiger Aero Seal
games.summary: Run, jump, and swim through glossy Aero seas as a cheerful seal. Collect bubbles and pearls, avoid urchins, chase the sun.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD move, Space jump, Escape pause
